about_the_game:
"Four Directions" is a turn-based strategy game. Based on the chess game, it cleverly integrates the mechanism tasks and card skills to enhance the game strategy and level fun.

Multiple Heroes

15 different heroes have appeared one after another, including sword knight, axe fighter, lancer fighter, archer, etc. Use the restraining properties of weapons to break a path in the enemy's attack.

Multiple Mechanisms

Each chapter has a carefully designed mechanism. Explore the decryption method of the mechanism in battle.

Multiple Cards

The game contains a variety of card skills, which can achieve different skills such as attribute enhancement, character cloning, character invisibility, space travel, etc. Cards can not only complete the confrontation with the enemy, but also be used to trigger mechanisms.

short_description: "Four Directions" is a turn-based strategy game that incorporates mechanical tasks and card skills based on the war chess game. Players will control 15 heroes, with different professions, use a variety of card skills, open mechanical devices on the chessboard map and confront the enemy head-on.
